title: v0.1 Foundation
description: Project structure, architecture, core schemas, evidence model, and audit trail.

title: v0.2 AI SOC Inbox
description: Alert ingestion, grouping, scoring, AI triage, and skeptic agent. The SOC Inbox UI moved to v0.2.5 Web Console.

title: v0.3 GRC Bridge
description: Control library, evidence packages, finding-to-control mapping, and risk register.

title: v0.4 Controlled Remediation
description: Execution layer for already-approved remediation: preconditions, backups, adapters, verification, and rollback. Policy engine and ActionPlan schema were delivered in the walking skeleton; approval moved to v0.2.4.

title: v0.5 Knowledge Loop
description: Knowledge candidates, promotion workflow, TTL, versioning, feedback, and detection tuning.

title: v1.0 End-to-End Demo
description: Complete workflow from raw alerts to incident, GRC evidence, remediation, verification, and knowledge update.

title: v0.1.5 Agent Workflow Runtime
description: Build the Flow / Task / Step / ToolCall / Artifact runtime that powers SOC investigations, GRC mapping, remediation workflows, and knowledge review.

title: v0.1.6 External Intelligence Ingestion
description: Build the source registry, connector, crawler-safety, raw document, extracted entity, and knowledge candidate foundation for external security intelligence enrichment.

title: v0.1.7 Authorized Security Validation
description: Build a safe, scoped, read-only validation layer that checks authorized targets and converts results into findings, evidence, risks, controls, and remediation plans.

title: v0.1.8 Curated Knowledge Intake
description: Build a secure manual upload, parsing, review, and promotion workflow for user-provided security documents, authorized lab writeups, advisories, rules, and remediation guidance.

title: v0.1.9 Assessment Authorization and Rules of Engagement
description: Turn user-provided assessment scope and pentest constraints into an explicit, reviewable, versioned, and deterministically enforced authorization policy.

title: v0.2.4 Approval Service and Local Authentication
description: Give the fail-closed policy engine a counterpart that can grant approval, with an authenticated identity behind every decision, and move persistence to PostgreSQL before the new tables land. Approval lifts the policy DENY for one plan; it never executes anything. Self-approval is risk-tiered on the ActionPlan RiskLevel. Single-tenant local auth, not production identity.

title: v0.2.5 Web Console
description: Replace the OpenAPI docs page with a browser console for capabilities that already exist in the backend: login, SOC Inbox, incident detail, approval queue, and audit chain viewer. Vite + React + TypeScript with OpenAPI-generated types.
